arxiv-2102-07206.title: Sample Efficient Subspace-based Representations for Nonlinear Meta-Learning
arxiv-2102-07206.creator: Halil Ibrahim Gulluk, Yue Sun, Samet Oymak, Maryam Fazel
arxiv-2102-07206.description: Abstract Constructing good representations is critical for learning complex tasks in a sample efficient manner. In the context of meta-learning, representations can be constructed from common patterns of previously seen tasks so that a future task can be learned quickly. While recent works show the benefit of subspace-based representations, such results are limited to linear-regression tasks.

arxiv-2110-04112.title: Qubit-efficient encoding scheme for quantum simulations of electronic structure
arxiv-2110-04112.creator: Yu Shee, Pei-Kai Tsai, Cheng-Lin Hong, Hao-Chung Cheng, Hsi-Sheng Goan
arxiv-2110-04112.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Yu Shee, Pei-Kai Tsai, Cheng-Lin Hong, Hao-Chung Cheng, Hsi-Sheng Goan. Simulating electronic structure on a quantum computer requires encoding of fermionic systems onto qubits. Common encoding methods transform a fermionic system of N N spin-orbitals into an N N -qubit system, but many of the fermionic configurations do not respect the required conditions and symmetries of the system so the qubit Hilbert space in this case may have unphysical states and thus can not be fully utilized.

arxiv-2311-18226.title: On the true detection probability of the uniformly optimal search plan
arxiv-2311-18226.creator: Liang Hong
arxiv-2311-18226.description: Abstract The gold standard for designing a search plan is to select a target distribution and then find the uniformly optimal search plan based on it. This approach has been successfully applied in several high-profile civil and military search missions.

arxiv-2401-09853.title: Game-theoretic Model Predictive Control for Modelling Competitive Supply Chains footnoteinfo This work is supported by the Swiss National Science Foundation via NCCR Automation (Grant Number 180545) and the Natural Sciences and Engineering Research Council of Canada (Reference Number RGPIN-2023-0325
arxiv-2401-09853.creator: Sophie Hall, Laura Guerrini, Florian Dörfler, Dominic Liao-McPherson
arxiv-2401-09853.description: Abstract Supply chains transform raw materials into finished goods and distribute them to end consumers. The vast majority of products we use daily are supplied to us through complex global supply chains. This paper proposes a modelling methodology for dynamic competitive supply chains based on game theory and model predictive control.

arxiv-2406-07492.title: Paraphrasing in Affirmative Terms Improves Negation Understanding
arxiv-2406-07492.creator: MohammadHossein Rezaei, Eduardo Blanco
arxiv-2406-07492.description: Abstract Negation is a common linguistic phenomenon. Yet language models face challenges with negation in many natural language understanding tasks such as question answering and natural language inference. In this paper, we experiment with seamless strategies that incorporate affirmative interpretations (i.e., paraphrases without negation) to make models more robust against negation. Crucially, our affirmative interpretations are obtained automatically.

arxiv-2410-04328.title: OD-Stega: LLM-Based Relatively Secure Steganography via Optimized Distributions
arxiv-2410-04328.creator: Yu-Shin Huang, Peter Just, Hanyun Yin, Krishna Narayanan, Ruihong Huang, Chao Tian
arxiv-2410-04328.description: Abstract We consider coverless steganography where a Large Language Model (LLM) is used to generate stego-texts in combination with arithmetic coding. An efficient method should embed secret bits in as few language tokens as possible while keeping the stego-text as natural as possible.

arxiv-2601-15924.title: Class–Confidence Aware Reweighting for Long-Tailed Learning
arxiv-2601-15924.creator: Brainard Philemon Jagati, Jitendra Tembhurne, Harsh Goud, Rudra Pratap Singh, Chandrashekhar Meshram
arxiv-2601-15924.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Brainard Philemon Jagati, Jitendra Tembhurne, Harsh Goud, Rudra Pratap Singh, Chandrashekhar Meshram. Deep neural network models degrade significantly in the long-tailed data distribution, with the overall training data dominated by a small set of classes in the head, and the tail classes obtaining less training examples.

In 1498 he was made principal of Magdalen Hall, and in 1 505 vice-president of Magdalen College. Soon after 1509 he was appointed a member of the royal council and chaplain to Henry VIII.

pmc-10593926.title: Study on creep characteristics and component model of saline soil in hexi corridor
pmc-10593926.creator: Yun-yan Yu, Chong-liang Luo, Wen-hao Cui, Jing-yan Tao, Ting-hua Zhang
pmc-10593926.description: Accurate mastery of the creep characteristics of unsaturated saline soil is extremely important for the long-term stability and safe operation of all types of buildings. In this paper, the research object focused on the saline soil of the Zhangye area, Hexi corridor.

pmc-10663227.title: The complementary roles of STAT3 and STAT1 in cancer biology: insights into tumor pathogenesis and therapeutic strategies
pmc-10663227.creator: Weiyuan Wang, Melanie Cristina Lopez McDonald, Christine Kim, Mirielle Ma, Zetao (Tommy) Pan, Charlotte Kaufmann, David A. Frank
pmc-10663227.description: STATs are a family of transcription factors that regulate many critical cellular processes such as proliferation, apoptosis, and differentiation. Dysregulation of STATs is frequently observed in tumors and can directly drive cancer pathogenesis. STAT1 and STAT3 are generally viewed as mediating opposite roles in cancer development, with STAT1 suppressing tumorigenesis and STAT3 promoting oncogenesis.

pmc-10671909.title: Non-Invasive Cardiac Output Measurement Using Inert Gas Rebreathing Method during Cardiopulmonary Exercise Testing—A Systematic Review
pmc-10671909.creator: Agnieszka Chwiedź, Łukasz Minarowski, Robert M Mróz, Hady Razak Hady, Christoph Sinning
pmc-10671909.description: Background: The use of inert gas rebreathing for the non-invasive cardiac output measurement has produced measurements comparable to those obtained by various other methods. However, there are no guidelines for the inert gas rebreathing method during a cardiopulmonary exercise test (CPET).

pmc-11432055.title: Effect of Sodium-Glucose Co-Transporter 2 Inhibitors Combined with Metformin on Pancreatic Cancer Cell Lines
pmc-11432055.creator: André Cristovão, Nelson Andrade, Fátima Martel, Cláudia Silva, Donatella Delle Cave
pmc-11432055.description: Pancreatic cancer (PC) is the ninth-leading cause of cancer-related deaths worldwide. Diabetic patients have an increased risk and mortality rates for PC. Sodium-glucose co-transporter 2 (SGLT2) inhibitors and metformin (Met) are widely used anti-diabetic medications. Both Met and SGLT2 inhibitors have anticancer properties in PC, but nothing is known concerning their combined effect.

pmc-11434567.title: Vaping: The Key to Quitting Cigarettes or a Gateway to Addiction?
pmc-11434567.creator: Jessica Emily Hill, Marepalli Bhaskara Rao, Tianyuan Guan, Jimmy T Efird
pmc-11434567.description: Background and Objectives: In 2022, the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) discovered that 2.55 million middle and high school students were using electronic cigarettes (e-cigarettes) in the US alone. E-cigarettes allow people to inhale a nicotine solution (e-liquid) into their bodies.

pmc-11477089.title: Influence of the Bone Marrow Microenvironment on Hematopoietic Stem Cell Behavior Post-Allogeneic Transplantation: Development of Clonal Hematopoiesis and Telomere Dynamics
pmc-11477089.creator: Myungshin Kim, Dain Kang, Hoon Seok Kim, Jong-Mi Lee, Silvia Park, Daehun Kwag, Chaeyeon Lee, Yuna Hong, Duyeon Na, Youngil Koh, Choong Hyun Sun, Hongyul An, Yoo-Jin Kim, Yonggoo Kim, Akiyoshi Takami
pmc-11477089.description: Allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation (allo-HSCT) is a potential cure for myelodysplastic neoplasms (MDSs) and other hematologic malignancies. This study investigates post-transplantation genetic evolution and telomere dynamics in hematopoietic cells, with a focus on clonal hematopoiesis (CH). We conducted a longitudinal analysis of 21 MDS patients who underwent allo-HSCT between September 2009 and February 2015.

pmc-11532193.title: Simplified methods for variance estimation in microbiome abundance count data analysis
pmc-11532193.creator: Yiming Shi, Lili Liu, Jun Chen, Kristine M. Wylie, Todd N. Wylie, Molly J. Stout, Chan Wang, Haixiang Zhang, Ya-Chen T. Shih, Xiaoyi Xu, Ai Zhang, Sung Hee Park, Hongmei Jiang, Lei Liu
pmc-11532193.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The complex nature of microbiome data has made the differential abundance analysis challenging. Microbiome abundance counts are often skewed to the right and heteroscedastic (also known as overdispersion), potentially leading to incorrect inferences if not properly addressed. In this paper, we propose a simple yet effective framework to tackle the challenges by integrating Poisson (log-linear) regression with standard error estimation through the Bootstrap method and Sandwich robust estimation.

pmc-11706721.title: Evolving Therapeutic Strategies in Esophageal Squamous Cell Carcinoma: Advances and Perspectives
pmc-11706721.creator: Zhibin Liu, Myoung Ok Kim
pmc-11706721.description: Esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (ESCC) is among the most prevalent forms of esophageal cancer globally, with a particularly high incidence in developing countries. Notably, Asia accounts for approximately 80% of global esophageal cancer cases, with China alone contributing to 54% of this burden.

pmc-12045076.title: Enhanced T cell activation and cytotoxicity against AML via targeted anti-CD99 nanoparticle treatment
pmc-12045076.creator: Shephali Kadam, Atham Ali, Mateusz Pospiech, Sandra Onyemaechi, Yiting Meng, Kanaka Dhuri, J Andrew MacKay, Houda Alachkar
pmc-12045076.description: CD99 is a transmembrane protein overexpressed in Acute Myeloid Leukemia (AML), presenting a potential novel therapeutic target. Our group has previously developed anti-CD99-A192 (α-CD99-A192), comprising of single chain variable fragment (scFv) and elastin-like polypeptides (ELPs), and reported promising anti-leukemic activity in AML preclinical models. Treatment with α-CD99-A192 induced apoptosis in AML cell lines and prolonged survival in AML xenograft models.

pmc-12608796.title: Discovery and Profiling of Protein Cysteine S-2-Carboxypropylation
pmc-12608796.creator: Jiabao Song, Kejun Yin, Ronghu Wu, Y. George Zheng
pmc-12608796.description: Methacrylyl-CoA is a key metabolic intermediate in the valine catabolic pathway. Its accumulation has been found to be cytotoxic and associated with pathological conditions. Nevertheless, detailed biological effects of methacrylyl-CoA and methacrylate in human physiology and pathology are poorly understood.

pmc-13174265.title: Functional chromatin signatures premark future lineage-specific enhancers
pmc-13174265.creator: Julian Pulecio, Zakieh Tayyebi, Dingyu Liu, Wilfred Wong, Renhe Luo, Jeyaram R Damodaran, Samuel J Kaplan, Nan Hu, Hyein S Cho, Jielin Yan, Dylan Murphy, Robert W Rickert, Abhijit Shukla, Aaron Zhong, Denis Torre, Qianzi Li, Federico González, Dexin Yang, Wenbo Li, Ting Zhou, Effie Apostolou, Christ
pmc-13174265.description: SummaryIt remains unknown whether early embryonic cells harbor a blueprint for future enhancers that regulate the expression of lineage-specific genes in adult tissues. Here, we demonstrate that embryonic stem cells (ESCs) have transcriptionally competent chromatin regions (CCRs) prepared to induce the expression of lineage genes prior to differentiation.

pmc-13467262.title: Correction: Gonzalez-Sanchez et al. Epithelial to Mesenchymal Transition Transcriptional Regulator ZEB1 in Liver Cancer: Oncogenic Roles and Therapeutic Potential. Int. J. Mol. Sci. 2025, 26, 11135
pmc-13467262.creator: Ester Gonzalez-Sanchez, Carlos Andres Roldan-Hernandez, Ana Martin-Ramirez, Lucia Garcia-Collado, Laura Fouassier, Javier Vaquero

pmc-13621518.title: Olfactory impairment associated with cognitive decline: findings from cognitive domain assessments among older adults in West Jakarta, Indonesia
pmc-13621518.creator: Yvonne Suzy Handajani, Yuda Turana, Antoninus Hengky, Kevin Kristian, Ji-Sook Kong
pmc-13621518.description: BackgroundOlfactory dysfunction has emerged as a potential early marker of neurodegenerative diseases. Despite growing interest, population-based evidence on its association with cognitive domains remains limited, particularly in low- and middle-income countries. This study examined the association between olfactory impairment and multidomain cognitive performance in older Indonesian adults.
